passage.text: Meet our Bangkok team at Blue Sky Travel!
passage.reading: ˈmiːt aʊər ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈtiːm ət ˈbluː ˈskaɪ ˈtrævəl!

passage.text: Our head office is in Singapore, but our office in Bangkok plans tours around Thailand.
passage.reading: aʊər ˈhɛd ˈɔːfɪs ɪz ɪn ˈsɪŋəpɔːr, bʌt aʊər ˈɔːfɪs ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈplænz ˈtʊrz əˈraʊnd ˈtaɪlænd.

passage.text: Mark Davis is the head of marketing.
passage.reading: ˈmɑːrk ˈdeɪvɪs ɪz ðə ˈhɛd əv ˈmɑːrkɪtɪŋ.

passage.text: He is from England, and he loves Thai food and Thai islands.
passage.reading: hiː ɪz frəm ˈɪŋɡlənd, ənd hiː ˈlʌvz ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd ənd ˈtaɪ ˈaɪləndz.

passage.text: His team makes videos and posts about our tours.
passage.reading: hɪz ˈtiːm ˈmeɪks ˈvɪdioʊz ənd ˈpoʊsts əˈbaʊt aʊər ˈtʊrz.

passage.text: This summer, Nam, a university student, is doing her internship on his team.
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈsʌmər, ˈnɑːm, ə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈstuːdənt, ɪz ˈduːɪŋ hɜːr ˈɪntɜːrnʃɪp ɑːn hɪz ˈtiːm.

passage.text: Pim Suwan is the head of sales.
passage.reading: ˈpɪm ˈsuːwɑːn ɪz ðə ˈhɛd əv ˈseɪlz.

passage.text: Her team talks to hotels and airlines every day.
passage.reading: hɜːr ˈtiːm ˈtɔːks tə hoʊˈtɛlz ənd ˈɛrlaɪnz ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: "Every day is different, so I never get bored," she says.
passage.reading: ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ ɪz ˈdɪfərənt, soʊ aɪ ˈnɛvər ˈɡɛt ˈbɔːrd, ʃiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: Nick Tan works in human resources.
passage.reading: ˈnɪk ˈtæn ˈwɜːrks ɪn ˌhjuːmən ˈriːsɔːrsɪz.

passage.text: He helps new people when they start at the company.
passage.reading: hiː ˈhɛlps ˈnuː ˈpiːpəl wɛn ðeɪ ˈstɑːrt ət ðə ˈkʌmpəni.

passage.text: Would you like to work with us? Send Nick an email!
passage.reading: wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə ˈwɜːrk wɪð ʌs? ˈsɛnd ˈnɪk ən ˈiːmeɪl!
